arguments.value: Ford Motor Media, a division of J. Walter Thompson (FMM), and iVillage, Inc., entered into a sponsorship agreement dated December 18, 1998. The agreement covers an initial two-month production period starting November 4, 1998, followed by a 24-month promotion period starting on the tentative launch date of January 4, 1999, for an initial term made up of those two periods. iVillage was to design, build, host, maintain, and promote a Ford-branded bridge site and related advertising and promotional programs across the iVillage network, while Ford paid an upfront nonrefundable setup fee plus quarterly fees. Ford received approval rights over the site and ads, and iVillage was the exclusive automobile manufacturer sponsor and advertiser on the network during the initial term, subject to stated exceptions. The agreement also covered reporting, publicity, confidentiality, intellectual property ownership in the created materials, indemnities, termination rights, and liability limits. The governing law is the laws of the State of New York.
